headline: Hero Motors and sector peers hit 10 percent lower circuits
hook: Thirty-one percent drop from post-listing peak
summary: Hero Motors share price fell to a 10 percent lower circuit at Rs 122.70 on the BSE on Wednesday. The stock is now down 31 percent from its post-listing high of Rs 179 recorded on October 5, 2026. Peers SML Mahindra and Wheels India were also locked at 10 percent lower circuits.
why_it_matters: Sharp correction hits recent auto sector listings.

headline: Pushkar Patwardhan to step down as CFO of SML Mahindra
hook: Chief Financial Officer steps down in October
summary: SML Mahindra Limited has announced that Pushkar Patwardhan will cease to be the Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel of the company. Retail investors should note leadership transitions in finance as they can influence near-term operational continuity.

headline: SML Mahindra September sales rise 32% despite sharp fall in exports
hook: Domestic demand offsets sharp export drop
summary: SML Mahindra reported a 32 percent increase in commercial vehicle sales for September, driving total sales up by 18 percent. This growth came despite a steep 62 percent decline in export volumes during the same month. Indian retail investors should note how domestic demand countered weak international markets for the commercial vehicle maker.
why_it_matters: Domestic sales resilience cushions SML Mahindra against export headwinds.
winners_losers: SML Mahindra gains / export peers hurt
